view.stem: 在整条直线$p$上取$A$为坐标原点，选定一个正方向，并以$1\text{ cm}$为一个坐标单位。线上的点可以是$A$本身。求到$A$的距离为$1\text{ cm}$、$2\text{ cm}$的所有点，并讨论到$A$的距离数值为实数$c$（以cm计）时点的个数。哪份完整记录正确？各记录的个数依次对应$c>0$、$c=0$、$c<0$。

options.text: 距离为1cm：坐标$-1,1$；距离为2cm：坐标$-2,2$。三种情况下点的个数依次为$2,1,0$。
距离为1cm：坐标$1$；距离为2cm：坐标$2$。三种情况下点的个数依次为$1,1,0$。
距离为1cm：坐标$-1,1$；距离为2cm：坐标$-2,2$。三种情况下点的个数依次为$2,2,2$。
距离为1cm：坐标$-1,1$；距离为2cm：坐标$-2,2$。三种情况下点的个数依次为$2,0,0$。

intent.task: Determine both loci at the two positive lengths and the complete cardinality rule, including the zero and impossible negative-distance boundaries, on a full line.
intent.source_solution: With A at0 and1cm as unit, |x|=1 gives x=-1,+1 and |x|=2 gives x=-2,+2. For |x|=c there are two distinct solutions if c>0, one point A if c=0, and no solution if c<0. If the source's distance parameter already presumes c>0, its ordinary case is two; the view explicitly expands c to real numerical values rather than calling a negative value a physical length.
intent.unit_reason: The two constructions and the general count are one two-ray locus task. A complete record preserves their connection and avoids independent clicks for each coordinate or count.
limitations: Recognizing coordinate loci does not demonstrate ruler construction of the four physical marks on the given line.
The view explicitly permits the base point at zero distance and lets c be any real distance number to expose feasibility boundaries; the written positive-distance case remains included.

rationales.derivation: Both rays yield one point for each positive distance. At c=0 the roots -c and+c coincide at A; the absolute value cannot be negative. The loci and count tuple are therefore (-1,1),(-2,2) and(2,1,0).
The positive-coordinate points are present, but the full line also contains -1 and-2. For each c>0 it contains two points, not one.
rationales.misconception: Replace the full straight line by its positive ray, solving x=c only with x>=0. This yields the single positive positions and count tuple(1,1,0).

rationales.derivation: The positive-distance loci are correct. At zero both symbolic roots are the same point; for negative c neither symbolic root has absolute value c. Thus the last two counts are wrong.
rationales.misconception: Write x=+c and x=-c mechanically and count the two displayed expressions as two solutions for every real c, without checking equality at zero or nonnegativity of |x|.

rationales.derivation: The zero-distance point A is expressly allowed, so there is one solution when c=0. Excluding it changes the requested locus.
rationales.misconception: Add the unstated restriction that the sought point must differ from A. This leaves both positive-distance loci intact but incorrectly removes the zero-distance solution.

The view adds a concrete measured instance, not purported source givens. For displacements(0,-6,-2,4,10)cm, right-positive coordinates are this tuple divided by the cm length of the unit. Left-positive reverses nonzero signs. Unit1/right gives(0,-6,-2,4,10); unit2/right gives(0,-3,-1,2,5); unit2/left gives(0,3,1,-2,-5); unit3/right would give(0,-2,-2/3,4/3,10/3).

limitations: The free source construction is instantiated with new, fully visible measured distances and O as the origin.
The response does not demonstrate freely placing five marks, using a ruler, or independently choosing and drawing a coordinate frame.
